テキスト cha 682: Born Shiyo 784, September 30. Height 140cm (as of Shiyo 800). A 1st-year at Motoki High School. She takes an interest in what is unknown and makes a hobby of unravelling it.
Small as a child and often mistaken for an elementary school pupil. Her mind is clear enough that she prides herself on being a genius girl, and she is something of a celebrity in Motoki-cho.

She seems to be on easy terms with Natsumi Kogori and Haruka Niimura, and often gives them counsel with the thinking power she was born with. She is a considerable big eater, and filling her stomach is not easily done. Cheerful as her character is, she is extremely serious when she thinks, and puts weight on a logical view.
When Natsumi Kogori's father is killed she resolves to find the culprit herself, but immediately afterward Erina Goto too is killed by someone.
Her meeting with Natsumi Kogori in middle school seems to have changed her view of life.
Haruka Niimura claims to be the culprit of the Megasawa City murders and the Central Park incident, and she tries to refute it from a logical standpoint.
She survives the butchery at the Kogori house, but having lost them all she loses her spirit, and out of her own sense of powerlessness she abandons all thought.

ロックシナリオ名: サード・ジェネレーション
テキスト cha 682: When Natsumi Kogori's throat is cut by someone, there is a description that reads as though an intuition like Natsumi Kogori's has come to her.
She meets Daijiro Ise, a police officer, and comes to exchange information with him.
To rescue Natsumi Kogori and Haruka Niimura, attacked by the shinigami at Sakuraoka, she rushes to the scene with Daijiro Ise. All the way there she tries to give apt instructions by telephone.

She exchanges views with Daijiro Ise on the culprit and the strangeness of his actions, and thanks him as fully as she can. Immediately afterward, however, something about Akane Kogori seems to strike her as wrong, and she urges her strongly to come in to the police.
When Haruka Niimura disappears she tries to keep as calm as she can, but the moment she sees her sister Momoko Goto's face she throws herself against her chest and wails with sadness and frustration.
The moment she sees Natsumi Kogori and Haruka Niimura slipping into the cafe Primavera, she sneaks out of cram school and joins the two of them.

When Daijiro Ise drops by unexpectedly, she is vague about where Natsumi Kogori is and even teases him, but she seems to have been watching the situation coolly, and she finds the bug left behind at the front door.

Gloomy and distrustful of people, she changes greatly after meeting Natsumi Kogori. She fights to get Natsumi Kogori a starting spot in the club, and although April sickness keeps it from happening, she feels the two of them saw one thing through together, and she turns respect and trust toward Natsumi Kogori.

シナリオ名: Haruka and the Witch and the Shinigami
テキスト cha 682: In Shiyo 802, two years after the Motoki-cho incident, she is on a train to the Arata settlement with Natsumi Kogori to look for Haruka Niimura. She seems aware that the Arata settlement is a dangerous place, but since Natsumi Kogori has decided to go, she goes along with firm resolve, even while getting cold feet.

She has entered the cherry-blossom festival eating contest since Shiyo 798 and has won every time. Her ability is overwhelming enough to leave grown men far behind, but faced with the national champion, it seems she had no wish to win from the start. Even so, that listless performance was more than enough to catch the champion's attention.
Haruka Niimura meant to consult Erina Goto about the paper doll and the Megasawa City case, but Erina seems to have already read that intention somehow.

Hearing Haruka Niimura out, she replies that she will work to be of help somehow. But everything she does afterward makes no sense, and not only Haruka Niimura but also Natsumi Kogori seem to think she is doing nothing but odd things.

First to drop out of the Russian-roulette takoyaki match. Natsumi Kogori excitedly analyzes that this was because Erina played only on the probabilities in front of her and forgot Zahha's side of the psychology, which exposed her emotional immaturity.

To dispel Haruka Niimura's belief that her own curse caused the series of cases, she explains the alibi trick of the Megasawa City case. Haruka Niimura is convinced by the theory that the Kogori couple carried it out, and at last she can accept that the curse was all in her mind.

Mifuyu Niimura never actually meant to lay a hand on the Kogori family, yet because a bug was planted in Haruka Niimura's smartphone, Erina wonders whether Haruka Niimura is the real target. When she reaches this idea, even Erina Goto shudders at how horrifying it is.

Haruka Niimura guesses that the Arata settlement is involved in some way in the Megasawa City case and the flayed-body case, but Erina Goto doubts it. If the Arata settlement were involved, there would be no need to drag in the Kogori family, and a settlement's worth of people would stand out. Even so, she apparently cannot rule out indirect involvement.

She managed to catch Mifuyu Niimura, but her deductions about the bug trick and the real target were wrong. However much Erina Goto is called a genius girl, not all of her deductions are correct, and flaws show up somewhere like this. Still, she kept hold of the parts that must not be misjudged at the very least, so it can be said they were spared an even more gruesome ending.
One of those who witnessed the accident in which Eiichiro Niimura died. But perhaps because she was 3 at the time, by Shiyo 800 she does not seem to remember it.
At age 5 in Shiyo 790 she had already met Natsumi Kogori. Even then she displayed a genius beyond her years, such as calculating probabilities by mental arithmetic.
Chigaya and Kana Niimura, the sisters, take a great liking to her, and she is carried off somewhere as if the two were fighting over her. Probably her life is not in danger. Probably.
The ghost story Erina Goto told was not especially original, but as if she had foreseen everyone's reaction, she made them all shudder with a prank planted in her smartphone.

Even Erina Goto's mind finds the ten years of deaths very troublesome, and she readily admits the culprit is smarter than she is. Even so, for Erika Niimura, whom she now accepts as a friend, she puts her mind to solving it, knowing it is reckless.
She stays by the gravely wounded Kana Niimura, and even after hearing from the doctor what chance there is of saving her, she prays for a miracle.

On August 1, Kana Niimura's birthday, she goes alone to the Arata settlement and looks back on the case at the secret base. Much of it stays speculation, but a vague lead toward a solution seems to be taking shape in her mind.

She proposed to Kana Niimura that they get along as sisters, but when she said she wanted to be close to Kana because she was on bad terms with her real older sister, Momoko Goto, Kana told her that was wrong. Told that the relationship only means something if she builds it with both of them, she realizes how presumptuous she was.

Natsumi Kogori told her it was dangerous and to get away from the cave, but there was no particular sign of danger, and she got home without incident. One could say she avoided the danger, but she apparently felt uneasy that there was not even a sign, and Haruka Niimura too remarks, "It's rare for danger sense to misfire."

She believes Natsumi Kogori and Sakura Niimura gained danger sense from being splashed with Eiichiro Niimura's blood, and even guesses that he once made Droga: his bad leg, she argues, comes from a side effect then, when, unable to control his strength, he was badly hurt (an open fracture). As for the curse-killings, she guesses there are several masterminds unaware the others are masterminds; their emotional interests coincide, so the killings happen with no communication between them. So no one's story holds a lie, making a contradiction extremely hard to find. Her one key point: why Sakura Niimura's head was cut off, which she says goes to the root of the curse-killings.

Though she does not believe in the supernatural or ghosts, she is extremely bad with haunted houses and the like. The reason: "because things are guaranteed to show up." When she actually goes into the Unreal Park haunted house with her older sister, Momoko Goto, her legs give out after only a few meters, and she makes a record-setting give-up. Afterward she clings to her family, wailing, and for a while cannot come back to her senses.

シナリオ名: 生まれ変わる家族たち
テキスト cha 682: On hearing of Erika Niimura's death, she cuts the trip short and returns home in a car driven by her older sister, Momoko Goto. On the way, Momoko confesses why she had kept her distance. Because Erina had the preconception that her sister was "kind of a delinquent and scary," she had been unable to reach out herself, and she recognizes this as a blunder she must admit. Realizing that what becomes of her relationship with her sister is up to her, she says, "No matter what, I'll always be your little sister" and "Stay with me, to make up for the time we spent apart," and talks her sister out of running away from home.

Kengo Shirozaki offers to tell them what remains unclear about the curse-killings, but out of respect for Natsumi Kogori's wishes, she returns to the Niimura main house that day without asking anything. However, she believes the real culprit is not Kotaro Niimura but someone else, and declaring that she cannot forgive that real culprit, she announces that she will hear Kengo out the next day. She also begins to doubt Natsumi's precognition itself, and guesses that it too may be involved as one part of the curse-killings.
She is worried about Kana Niimura, who has been left behind in the Arata settlement, and thinks of having her live at her home in Motoki-cho for the time being.

She faces Chigaya Niimura, whom she took to be the culprit of the curse-killings, and, undaunted even when threatened with a knife, calmly presses her on her motive and methods. Chigaya seems to give in and confess, but with one remark, that she too had wanted to kill Sakura Niimura, Erina realizes that her deductions so far were all wrong. Having been confident and certain of her deduction this time, she is enraged and punches the tatami again and again. Even so, she manages to regain her composure, and tries to think about what to do for Kana Niimura's future rather than about the case.

After a suicide attempt born of her own powerlessness, she lost her voice and her will, but she puts her one remaining talent, eating, to use and enters the national championship. After fierce battles with the queen of competitive eating and with Chigaya Niimura, she wins the national title and regains her voice and her will. But her guilt at failing to save Natsumi Kogori and Haruka Niimura never fades, and as if to cover it up, she carries out humanitarian aid around the world. Those efforts earn her the Nobel Peace Prize, but at the speech she pours out her heart to the world, and she will go on living caught up in that guilt.

シナリオ名: サード・ジェネレーション
テキスト cha 682: Touching Natsumi Kogori's blood gives her the constitution of the third generation, and she foresees dangers that could happen. Everything she saw happen in the Arata settlement in this scenario took place within her danger sense. She urges Mifuyu Niimura to turn herself in, and also learns what happened in Megasawa City and of Chigaya Niimura's frenzy, which set off the Megasawa City case. Her time with Momoko Goto in the danger sense seems to have left a strong impression, and after returning to the real world she appears to have reconciled with her.

She had Natsumi Kogori, who lost her parents and visits Haruka Niimura in the hospital, staying at her home. But when she sees Natsumi talking with Haruka, who has not woken up, she begins to worry about her, yet cannot bring herself to tell her the truth. When Natsumi collapses with a stomach ulcer, she tells her the truth so that things will not get worse. To treat the Green-Eye Curse-Killing Haruka then develops, she negotiates with the police and the hospital, arranges Natsumi's exchange transfusion, uncovers how the two are related, and supports them both throughout.

シナリオ名: パラサイト・プリズン
テキスト cha 682: To trace Haruka Niimura's whereabouts, she carries out the research she needs as director of the International Research Institute. She roughly works out the true nature of the goshinboku and the source of the disaster, but cannot save Natsumi Kogori and the others. In the end, Haruka kills her, saying that "dying alone would be sad."

シナリオ名: メガミゴロシミナゴロシ
テキスト cha 682: She comes to the Arata settlement with Natsumi Kogori, but is captured by the residents. Rescued by Haruka Niimura, she reasons through the chain of events again and again, but is strangled by Chigaya Niimura.

At Mifuyu Niimura's request, she sets out her deductions about the curse-killings in Tokyo. According to them, every event that looks paranormal is something someone is making look paranormal. Those events cannot be explained by present-day science, so without that knowledge they look paranormal: that is her reasoning.

She keeps in touch with Chigaya Niimura until the day before Chigaya vanishes. After the disappearance, some of what she says suggests she regrets advising Chigaya to hurry to the Arata settlement, but that surely comes from simple worry for Chigaya.

シナリオ名: 黙示録のラッパ吹き～しょう失～
テキスト cha 682: Realizing that Natsumi Kogori set off the apocalyptic sound, she at once isolates Natsumi in a room of the Niimura house. She also blames Kana Niimura for it, but realizing it was her own mistake not to have told Kana to keep quiet, she quickly works to make up with her.

シナリオ名: 黙示録のラッパ吹き～しょう失～
テキスト cha 682: She wonders whether Shigatsu Youka alone could bring about the whole chain of events, and whether there might be a human spy; right after, the storehouse of the Niimura main house catches fire. She is certain this is the work of human hands.

シナリオ名: 黙示録のラッパ吹き～徘徊～
テキスト cha 682: With Haruka Niimura so late in coming back, she sets out to search for her with Kana Niimura and Natsumi Kogori. Natsumi's five senses are an open book to Shigatsu Youka, but she plans to turn this ability around and feed Shigatsu Youka false information.

シナリオ名: 黙示録のラッパ吹き～裏切り～
テキスト cha 682: Thanks to Chigaya Niimura's sudden appearance, she escapes the residents' attack. But in a three-way standoff between Shigatsu Youka, Chigaya, and the residents, she judges that Chigaya's plan will be hard to pull off even if Chigaya is in her right mind, and she heads back alone along the path to the settlement. Still, that plan holds only if Chigaya is on their side; she blames herself, thinking that if Chigaya is one of the dead or has betrayed them, she should never have let Natsumi Kogori and the others go to the abandoned hut.

シナリオ名: 黙示録のラッパ吹き～伝承～
テキスト cha 682: She returns to the settlement alone, but seeing how utterly ordinary the residents are acting, she becomes certain that the group that attacked them in the forest were corpses.

シナリオ名: 黙示録のラッパ吹き～伝承～
テキスト cha 682: Talking with Erika Niimura, she learns the lore of the past, and when Erika tells her that Chigaya Niimura is in the underground storeroom, she sets out to search again.

シナリオ名: 黙示録のラッパ吹き～焦点～
テキスト cha 682: With Erika Niimura, she finds Chigaya Niimura in the underground storeroom. By now she already feels something is off about Kotaro Niimura, and she tries to ask Chigaya, who senses the same, for her opinion, but Chigaya hurries her on, saying they must head for the summit first.

シナリオ名: 黙示録のラッパ吹き～虚虚実実～
テキスト cha 682: She goes with Chigaya Niimura down the tunnel that leads to Shigatsu Youka, but on the way she realizes that Chigaya has become fourth generation, parasitized by Shigatsu Youka. She will be taken away no matter what, but to buy time until Kana Niimura arrives, she fakes crying and tries to set the two against each other. Incidentally, 'Bluff and Counter-Bluff' means both sides fighting with every scheme and means they have; it also describes mixing lies with truth as each side tries to read the other's mind.
